newsitem.title: USA: Texas trims prorated natural gas field allowables.
newsitem.headline: Texas trims prorated natural gas field allowables.

text.p: The Texas Railroad Commission on Thursday set November production allowables for the state's prorated fields at 2.8 billion cubic feet per day (bcfd), or 93 percent of actual November 1995 production.
The November allowable is 88 percent of last year's September allowable for prorated fields of 3.19 bcfd, said the commission, which regulates oil and natural gas production in the Texas.

Current estimated Texas natural gas in storage is up from last month. On October 15, the commission estimated Texas gas storage stood at 216.3 billion cubic feet (bcf), up from 167.3 bcf at the end of September and 287.5 bcf at the end of September 1995.
